description.value: Meng Fan Restaurant is a Chinese takeout and dine-in spot in Dawson Creek, the starting point of the Alaska Highway and a major waypoint for northbound touring cyclists. The menu centres on Cantonese-influenced classics — chow mein, fried rice, ginger beef, and combination dinners — with online ordering available for both delivery and pickup. It represents one of the few full-service Chinese restaurants in this remote northern hub.
